Mood Board Maker

Arrange up to 9 photos into a beautiful mood-board collage with a title — perfect for design inspiration.

Images stay on your device — the collage is built locally in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Click "Choose images" and select up to 9 photos.
  2. Type a board title and pick a background color.
  3. The collage preview updates live.
  4. Click "Download board" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What size is the mood board?

The board is 1200 × 900 px PNG. Images are cover-cropped to fill their tiles so the board always looks full.

How are the photos arranged?

It adapts: 1 photo fills the board, 2–9 photos use a balanced grid layout.

Are my photos uploaded?

Yes — everything happens in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
